name: Raymond Ltd
title: Raymond Ltd - 500330 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Engineering (aero + precision auto) EBITDA up sharply on synergies, but Q4 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 13.9% from 16.4% and FY26 flat at INR335 crores; INR930 crores five-year capex is the supply signal.

utilisation.quote: we have the capacity to grow this business by 25% for next year within our existing system

capex.quote: Raymond is embarking on a transformative INR930 crores capital expenditure program over the next 5 years

triggers.label: Capex INR930 crores over 5 years
triggers.quote: Raymond is embarking on a transformative INR930 crores capital expenditure program over the next 5 years to meet surging international demand.

triggers.label: Aero growth 25% CAGR target
triggers.quote: we will continue to keep our trend of 25% growth till we reach the new greenfield facility

triggers.label: Andhra commercial start late CY27
triggers.quote: It will be in the second half -- it will be like second half or towards the last quarter FY '28

triggers.label: Auto tariffs cut to 18%
triggers.quote: in automotive, the tariffs are definitely down to 18% now

guidance.quote: we are targeting a 25% growth year-on-year
I would say 250 is possible to be made this year
Raymond is embarking on a transformative INR930 crores capital expenditure program over the next 5 years

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA margin down 250bp on lower other income
red_flags.quote: EBITDA stood at INR85 crores with an EBITDA margin of 13.9% in Q4 FY '26

red_flags.label: Aero order book ~5x annual revenue, conversion gap questioned
red_flags.quote: when we're looking at this order book of INR2,300 crores over 5 years, it's just INR460 crores a year

red_flags.label: Management evasive on order book breakup and cash reconciliation
red_flags.quote: I don't think it's okay for me to give you a direct breakup

evasions.topic: LEAP / engine programme order book breakup
evasions.quote: I don't think it's okay for me to give you a direct breakup
These are just orders that you've had in the past.
So, there are investments in other marketable securities, right?
